title: TCF corner
subtitle: Unit 14: Free time and simple plans

steps.title: Exam style
steps.body: These questions look like the real TCF Canada: one play, four options, one answer. A wrong and a blank answer both score zero, so always choose.

steps.fr: Je préfère la lecture et la danse.
steps.question: Which two hobbies does the speaker prefer?
steps.explain: The speaker names la lecture and la danse.

steps.fr: Oui, avec plaisir. On va au spectacle samedi.
steps.question: What is the reply?
options: The person is busy and declines
The person asks about a clinic
The person accepts and plans to go to a show
steps.explain: Oui, avec plaisir accepts; they plan to go to the show Saturday.

steps.fr: Désolé, je suis occupé vendredi soir.
steps.question: Why can't the speaker go Friday evening?
options: The speaker is at a concert
steps.explain: The speaker says je suis occupé.

steps.fr: La sortie commence à dix-huit heures.
steps.question: What time does the outing start?

steps.explain: The notice says salle de spectacle.
steps.promptFr: CONCERT · Vendredi, 20 h · Salle de spectacle

steps.explain: The invitation says dimanche à 11 h.
steps.promptFr: INVITATION · Cabane à sucre · Dimanche à 11 h
PATINAGE · Samedi, 15 h · Patinoire du Parc
